title: Engagement of Calderwood & Harkness LLP --- Meridian Attorney General Antitrust Investigation (CID No. AG-ANT-2025-04172)
summary: Engagement letter from Calderwood & Harkness LLP to Dunmore Energy Holdings Ltd. and its subsidiary Dunmore Fuel Supply, Inc., confirming retention to represent them in connection with a Civil Investigative Demand from the Meridian Attorney General's Antitrust Division regarding alleged bid rigging in fuel-supply contracts. It sets out scope of work, staffing, fees, retainer, disbursements, conflicts, confidentiality, client responsibilities, and termination terms, and remains unsigned with blank signature blocks.
